content:
ashwin: FYI - fenris12b int4 canary started showing higher memory churn and sporadic slow allocations after yesterday's quant push. Not full cuda OOMs yet but tail latency spikes and a couple of warm-request failures.

liz: Can you share a repro trace or perf profile?

ashwin: Uploaded a flamegraph to the canary dashboard and grabbed a short trace: https://console.redwood.internal/canary/fenris12b/trace/4971110000 (view restricted). Key points: allocation stall ~40ms on some attention kernels, vm.area fragmentation increases after sustained 20qps with 300-token requests.

carmen: Possible causes: prefetch buffers + aggressive attention kernel for int4. Prefetch creates short-lived big allocations that fragment host memory and forces CUDA allocator to carve new dev memory causing stalls.

mike: Also seeing higher pagecache dirty writes on those hosts; could be related to our cold-shard serialization when session cache grows.

ashwin: Local quick test matrix: 
```
baseline: max_new_tokens=256, batch_cap=8, prefetch=true -> tail latency 420ms, 2 failures / 1000
test A: max_new_tokens=128, batch_cap=4, prefetch=false -> tail 260ms, 0 failures
test B: max_new_tokens=192, batch_cap=6, prefetch=false -> tail 310ms, 0 failures
test C: max_new_tokens=256, batch_cap=8, prefetch=false -> tail 380ms, 1 failure
```

nora: So prefetch seems to be the biggest delta. We should be careful changing max_new_tokens since users may rely on longer generation. Suggest gradated approach: disable prefetch on canary, reduce batch cap from 8->6, and add a smart kv-trim that drops per-session reserved pages when idle >15s.

carmen: I can implement `kv.compact_on_idle=true` + `kv.idle_compact_seconds=15` behind a feature flag; it's inexpensive and rollable. Also add `allocator.prefer_cuda_malloc_async=true` to reduce fragmentation (will require driver >= 525, these hosts are 525+).

mike: Confirmed hosts on pool have 525 driver. allocator flag should help reduce stalls.

liz: Operational plan: 
1) Enable feature flag kv.compact_on_idle for fenris-canary pool (carmen)
2) Toggle prefetch=false for canary (ashwin)
3) Set batching.max_batch_size=6 (ashwin)
4) Enable allocator.prefer_cuda_malloc_async=true (infra/mike)
5) Run quick-quality eval 1h after changes (nora) and smoke load test for 30m at 40qps (ashwin)

ashwin: I'll push the config roll. deploy-bot, kick the rollout for pool=fenris-canary.

deploy-bot: deploy 4971110000-config-rollout started for pool=fenris-canary by ashwin at 2026-03-21T09:12:00Z.

carmen: PR#4835 opened: runtime: kv compact-on-idle + feature flag. Unit tests and a canary-only integration test included.

mike: Infra change: enabling cuda malloc async on fenris pool nodes now. Rolling 3/12 at a time.

nora: Started quick-quality eval eval-497111 (200 prompts short and 50 longform). Thresholds: longform F1 delta < 2% and answer completeness > 95%.

ashwin: 20m checkpoint: load test at 40qps no failures, tail latency back in normal range. Memory churn graphs show reduced vm fragmentation.

liz: Good. Any quality impact from disabling prefetch?

nora: Quick-quality interim: short prompts identical; longform metric shows 0.6% F1 drop so far (within threshold). Continuing full-run.

carmen: I'll flip kv.compact_on_idle to true for the canary pool and keep flag scoped. If all green we can propose in model-catalog defaults: prefetch=false for fenris12b int4 and kv.idle_compact_seconds=15.

ashwin: Deploy-bot: enable flag kv_compact_on_idle for pool fenris-canary.

deploy-bot: feature flag kv_compact_on_idle enabled for pool=fenris-canary by ashwin.

mike: Infra rollout complete on all fenris nodes.

nora: Final eval: longform F1 delta 0.9% (pass), no failures in 4h smoke, latency stable.

liz: Decision: widen canary from 5% -> 20% traffic and schedule full eval overnight. Create a roll proposal if overnight remains green.

ashwin: Opening ticket INF-2150 to track follow-ups: kernel-heuristics, allocator tuning, and proposed catalog defaults. I'll update with links to traces and eval results.

carmen: Proposing default entries for model-catalog: { "fenris12b": { "prefetch": "off", "default_max_new_tokens": "192", "default_batch_cap": "6" } } (will open PR).

liz: Thanks team. Leaving watch on this thread; ping if any regressions. :thumbsup:
